name: iMessage (Apple Messages)
refreshNote: No official tool. Previews are generated on the sender's device when the link is sent; there is no server-side cache to purge. Changing the URL forces a new fetch.
notes: Official (Apple TN3156 'Create rich previews for Messages', 2024-04-30, formerly TN2444): default preview is a grey bubble with page title, domain and small icon; og:image adds a large image; og:title sets the title; use og:site_name for the site name rather than putting branding in og:title.

Images should be at least 900px wide; images under 150px wide may be ignored or shown as icons (minWidth=150 is that threshold, recommendedWidth=900). Icons should be square, >= 108px (apple-touch-icon / favicon / <link rel> icon). Main HTML resource limited to 1MB; total of icons/images/videos limited to 10MB (maxBytes=10485760 is that total). Apple notes these are guidelines that may change.
og:video or twitter:player:stream pointing to a playable file (e.g. MP4) autoplays inline; HLS needs a tap.

og:description is shown only for social-network post previews (which also require twitter:card summary/summary_large_image and a link rel=alternate type=application/activity+json); ordinary pages show title + domain only.
No JavaScript and no meta-refresh redirects are followed; server redirects are. Image crop ratio not documented (null). Format list is an estimate (JPEG/PNG/GIF); SVG not supported (estimate).
The fetch is made from the sender's device with a Safari UA that appends 'facebookexternalhit/1.1 Facebot Twitterbot/1.0' (secondary sources).
Source note: TN3156 was fetched directly from developer.apple.com (JSON) and read in full.
